title: Laila ki jaan akbar sarwar ki jaan
body:
Laila ke lal Akbar Sarwar ki jaan akbar....(2)
Ahle haram ki
dharas kadiyal jawan akbar....
1.kehte the shahe wala akbar mere kahan ho..
Ghar ko ujaar kar tum beta chale kahan ho...
Behno pa rahm khao ruthe huye
kahan ho..
Laila ke lal Akbar Sarwar ki jaan akbar....(2)
2.zakhmi badan se aayi aawaaz mai yahan hoon..
Baba mai kaise aao'n khaye howe sina hoon..
Khoo'n behchuka hai sara zakhmo'n se neem ja hoon....
Laila ke lal Akbar Sarwar ki jaan akbar....(2)
3.dete the shahe wala aawaz yeh bahen ko...
Aankhon me hai andhera jauo'n mai kaise ran ko..
Jaakar qareebe akbar kaise sambhalu'n man ku....
Laila ke lal Akbar Sarwar ki jaan akbar....(2)
4.rasta kisi ne roka khanjar kisi ne maara..
Naiza kisi ne phenka patthar kisi ne maara..
Gurze gira'n jawa'n ke sar par kisi ne maara..
Laila ke lal Akbar Sarwar ki jaan akbar....(2)
5.naazo'n se tujh ko paala aththara saal beta..
Aankhon ko kholo dekho Zainab ka haal beta..
Kaise jiyegi madar ab hai sawal beta..
Laila ke lal Akbar Sarwar ki jaan akbar....(2)
6.laasha tera pada hai jalti howi zamee'n par...
Baithe gi ab nai madar saye me zindagi bhar..
Noke sina pa kaise dekhegi wo tera sar....
Laila ke lal Akbar Sarwar ki jaan akbar....(2)
7.shayer GULAAM tera  SHAHKAR nohakhwan hai..
ek munfarid qalm hai Masoom ek zuba'n hai...
Ashko'n ka ek darya har aankh se rawa'n hai...
Laila ke lal Akbar Sarwar ki jaan akbar....(2)
